cost: Parsing O(text+compiled regex bytes). allowed scans all rules, regex cost depends on pattern and path lengths. Gate storage O(hosts+rules); DNS, HTTP and sleeps unbounded externally. Nonfinite/negative crawl-delay can panic in Duration conversion.
description: Robots parses user-agent groups, selects all matching specific agents else wildcard groups, compiles literal/glob path patterns, and evaluates longest byte-length match with allow tie. Gate caches host rules, rejects GitHub names/addresses, fetches robots on first host and paces approved requests.
forward: Robots parses user-agent groups, selects all matching specific agents else wildcard groups, compiles literal/glob path patterns, and evaluates longest byte-length match with allow tie. Gate caches host rules, rejects GitHub names/addresses, fetches robots on first host and paces approved requests.
inverse: Within valid finite-delay states, denied path cannot pass Gate.check; known GitHub host rejects before robots request. A 4xx robots response becomes allow-all, including 403/429, while 5xx/transport errors cache deny-all. No DNS or HTTP routes are executed here.

An allowed boolean has many compatible rule sets and paths; false constrains the maximal matching raw pattern length to a disallow with no tied allow. Gate result cannot reconstruct fetch history without cache/clock state.
limitations: No network/DNS/download, real catalog/corpus/model/teacher or database execution. Effect paths are source-derived; finite helper tests are not universal verification. No executable percentage surrogate or speed claim; future caps require metric/domain/reference and remain 1/2/5/10%.
state: Specific agent selection excludes wildcard groups when any specific match exists. Rule length counts raw pattern bytes including wildcard/end marker. Cache keys are lowercased host strings, not complete origins; clock pacing uses request-start timestamps at Gate and completion timestamps in Polite.
